options.text: I'd say it's fine but feel stung for hours.
I'd need to know the real reason.
I'd wonder what I did wrong.
I'd tell three other people about it.

reframe: // That reaction? Automatic. Your ego filled in the story before your brain caught up.

situation: Someone at work takes credit for your idea in a meeting.

options.text: I'd find a way to prove it was mine.
I'd say nothing but replay it all day.
I'd drop hints about my other wins.
I'd laugh it off and change the subject.

reframe: // The sting isn't about the idea. It's about what the idea meant about you.

situation: You post something personal online. Zero engagement.

options.text: I'd delete it before anyone notices.
I'd check repeatedly to see if it changes.
I'd post something clever to recover.
I'd build a narrative about why it didn't land.

reframe: // Silence shouldn't feel like a verdict. But your ego doesn't know that yet.
